api/src/routers/embed.py.name: Embedded apps and forms
api/src/routers/embed.py.description: Shows apps and forms inside another website's page, letting in only properly signed links.

api/src/routers/endpoints.py.name: Keyed workflow calls
api/src/routers/endpoints.py.description: Runs a workflow when an outside system calls it with the right key, with no person signing in.

api/src/routers/events.py.name: Event sources
api/src/routers/events.py.description: Manages the outside services that send the platform news, what should happen when news arrives, and the delivery history.

api/src/routers/executions.py.name: Workflow run history
api/src/routers/executions.py.description: Shows workflow runs with their results, logs and values, and lets you cancel stuck or unwanted runs.

api/src/routers/export_import.py.name: Workspace export and import
api/src/routers/export_import.py.description: Copies knowledge, settings, tables and connections out of one workspace and into another as files.

api/src/routers/files.py.name: File storage
api/src/routers/files.py.description: Reads, writes, moves, searches and shares files in cloud storage, with folder permissions and a browser editor.

api/src/routers/form_embed_secrets.py.name: Form embed keys
api/src/routers/form_embed_secrets.py.description: Creates and rotates the keys that let a form be shown inside another website.

api/src/routers/forms.py.name: Forms and submissions
api/src/routers/forms.py.description: Builds the forms people fill in, controls whether they are public, and runs the workflow behind each submission.

GET /embed/apps/{slug}.name: Show app on another site
GET /embed/apps/{slug}.description: Checks the signed link and shows the app inside another website's page.

GET /embed/forms/public/{public_key}.name: Open a public form
GET /embed/forms/public/{public_key}.description: Starts a short visit for a published form so an outside visitor can fill it in.

GET /embed/forms/public/{public_key}/fra.name: Public form display rules
GET /embed/forms/public/{public_key}/fra.description: Tells the browser which websites may show this public form in a frame.

GET /embed/forms/hmac/{form_id}/frame-po.name: Signed form display rules
GET /embed/forms/hmac/{form_id}/frame-po.description: Allows a form shared by signed link to be shown inside any website.

GET /embed/forms/{form_id}.name: Show form on another site
GET /embed/forms/{form_id}.description: Checks the signed link and shows the form inside another website's page.

GET /api/events/adapters.name: Event service types
GET /api/events/adapters.description: Lists the outside services the platform can receive news from.

POST /api/events/adapters/{adapter_name}.name: Event service choices
POST /api/events/adapters/{adapter_name}.description: Fetches the live choices for a setting when connecting an outside service.

GET /api/events/sources.name: Event sources
GET /api/events/sources.description: Lists the connections that bring news in from outside services, for platform administrators.

POST /api/events/sources.name: Add an event source
POST /api/events/sources.description: Connects a new outside service so its news can start arriving.

GET /api/events/sources/{source_id}.name: Event source details
GET /api/events/sources/{source_id}.description: Shows one connection's settings, for platform administrators.

PATCH /api/events/sources/{source_id}.name: Edit an event source
PATCH /api/events/sources/{source_id}.description: Changes a connection's settings, such as which events to accept.

POST /api/events/sources/{source_id}/res.name: Reconnect an event source
POST /api/events/sources/{source_id}/res.description: Replaces the outside service's subscription so news starts arriving again.

POST /api/events/sources/{source_id}/rot.name: Change an event signing key
POST /api/events/sources/{source_id}/rot.description: Sets a new signing key so only genuinely signed messages are accepted.

DELETE /api/events/sources/{source_id}.name: Delete an event source
DELETE /api/events/sources/{source_id}.description: Permanently removes a connection and stops its news arriving.

GET /api/events/sources/{source_id}/subs.name: What happens on an event
GET /api/events/sources/{source_id}/subs.description: Lists the actions set up for a connection's events, for platform administrators.

POST /api/events/sources/{source_id}/sub.name: Add an event action
POST /api/events/sources/{source_id}/sub.description: Sets up what should happen when a particular event arrives.

PATCH /api/events/sources/{source_id}/su.name: Edit an event action
PATCH /api/events/sources/{source_id}/su.description: Changes which events an action responds to or what it runs.

DELETE /api/events/sources/{source_id}/s.name: Remove an event action
DELETE /api/events/sources/{source_id}/s.description: Deletes an action so that event no longer triggers anything.

GET /api/events/sources/{source_id}/subs.name: Event action details
GET /api/events/sources/{source_id}/subs.description: Shows one action set up for an event, for platform administrators.

GET /api/events/sources/{source_id}/even.name: Events received
GET /api/events/sources/{source_id}/even.description: Lists the news that has arrived from a connection, with filters.

POST /api/events/emit.name: Announce a platform event
POST /api/events/emit.description: Announces that something happened so anything listening can react, and reports how many listeners there are.

GET /api/events/topics.name: Event name list
GET /api/events/topics.description: Lists the event names the platform knows about plus any already in use.

GET /api/events/{event_id}.name: Event details
GET /api/events/{event_id}.description: Shows one received event and its content, for platform administrators.

GET /api/events/{event_id}/deliveries.name: Event deliveries
GET /api/events/{event_id}/deliveries.description: Lists each attempt to hand an event to its actions, including failures.

POST /api/events/{event_id}/deliveries.name: Deliver an event again
POST /api/events/{event_id}/deliveries.description: Sends an existing event to one more action.

POST /api/events/deliveries/{delivery_id.name: Retry a failed delivery
POST /api/events/deliveries/{delivery_id.description: Tries again to hand an event to an action that failed.

GET /api/executions.name: Workflow runs
GET /api/executions.description: Lists workflow runs with filters for workflow, status and date.

GET /api/executions/logs.name: Diagnostic logs
GET /api/executions/logs.description: Lists detailed diagnostic messages for people allowed to see every log.

GET /api/executions/{execution_id}.name: Run details
GET /api/executions/{execution_id}.description: Shows one workflow run's status, timing and outcome.

GET /api/executions/{execution_id}/resul.name: Run result
GET /api/executions/{execution_id}/resul.description: Returns what a finished workflow run produced.

GET /api/executions/{execution_id}/logs.name: Run logs
GET /api/executions/{execution_id}/logs.description: Shows the step-by-step messages a workflow run wrote.

GET /api/executions/{execution_id}/varia.name: Run values
GET /api/executions/{execution_id}/varia.description: Shows the values a workflow run held while it worked.

POST /api/executions/{execution_id}/canc.name: Cancel a workflow run
POST /api/executions/{execution_id}/canc.description: Stops a queued or running workflow run.

GET /api/executions/cleanup/stuck.name: Runs that look stuck
GET /api/executions/cleanup/stuck.description: Lists workflow runs that may need clearing up because they never finished.

POST /api/executions/cleanup/trigger.name: Clear stuck runs
POST /api/executions/cleanup/trigger.description: Cleans up workflow runs that are stuck so the system keeps moving.

POST /api/executions/cleanup/redis-orpha.name: Clear orphaned runs
POST /api/executions/cleanup/redis-orpha.description: Removes leftover queued runs that no longer have anything behind them.

POST /api/export-import/export/knowledge.name: Export knowledge
POST /api/export-import/export/knowledge.description: Packages stored documents into a file for moving to another workspace.

POST /api/export-import/export/configs.name: Export settings
POST /api/export-import/export/configs.description: Packages saved settings into a file for moving to another workspace.

POST /api/export-import/export/tables.name: Export tables
POST /api/export-import/export/tables.description: Packages tables and their records into a file for moving elsewhere.

POST /api/export-import/export/integrati.name: Export connections
POST /api/export-import/export/integrati.description: Packages outside service connections into a file for moving elsewhere.

POST /api/export-import/export/all.name: Export everything
POST /api/export-import/export/all.description: Packages your knowledge, settings, tables and connections into one file.

POST /api/export-import/import/knowledge.name: Import knowledge
POST /api/export-import/import/knowledge.description: Adds documents from an exported file into this workspace.

POST /api/export-import/import/tables.name: Import tables
POST /api/export-import/import/tables.description: Adds tables and their records from an exported file into this workspace.

POST /api/export-import/import/configs.name: Import settings
POST /api/export-import/import/configs.description: Adds settings from an exported file into this workspace.

POST /api/export-import/import/integrati.name: Import connections
POST /api/export-import/import/integrati.description: Adds outside service connections from an exported file into this workspace.

POST /api/export-import/import/all.name: Import everything
POST /api/export-import/import/all.description: Adds knowledge, settings, tables and connections from one exported file.

GET /api/files/policies.name: Folder permissions
GET /api/files/policies.description: Lists who may read or change files in each folder.

POST /api/files/policies/test.name: Test folder access
POST /api/files/policies/test.description: Checks whether a given person could open or change a particular file.

POST /api/files/structure.name: Folder contents map
POST /api/files/structure.description: Lists what physically exists in a folder, for administrators, so the file tree never hides anything.

GET /api/files/policies/{policy_path:pat.name: Folder permission
GET /api/files/policies/{policy_path:pat.description: Shows the rule that decides who may use one folder.

PUT /api/files/policies/{policy_path:pat.name: Set folder permission
PUT /api/files/policies/{policy_path:pat.description: Creates or replaces the access rule for a folder.

DELETE /api/files/policies/{policy_path:.name: Remove folder permission
DELETE /api/files/policies/{policy_path:.description: Deletes the access rule for a folder.

POST /api/files/read.name: Read a file
POST /api/files/read.description: Returns a file's contents from cloud storage or the server.

POST /api/files/write.name: Save a file
POST /api/files/write.description: Writes a file to cloud storage or the server.

POST /api/files/move.name: Move a file
POST /api/files/move.description: Moves one file to a new place in the background.

POST /api/files/move-many.name: Move many files
POST /api/files/move-many.description: Moves up to 500 files to a new place in one background job.

POST /api/files/list.name: List files
POST /api/files/list.description: Lists the files in a folder.

POST /api/files/exists.name: Check a file exists
POST /api/files/exists.description: Tells you whether a file is there.

POST /api/files/stat.name: File details
POST /api/files/stat.description: Returns a file's size and when it last changed.

POST /api/files/signed-url.name: Get direct file link
POST /api/files/signed-url.description: Creates a link that lets a browser send or fetch one file directly.

POST /api/files/complete-upload.name: Finish a browser upload
POST /api/files/complete-upload.description: Records a file that a browser uploaded directly so the platform can use it.

POST /api/files/signed-urls.name: Get links for many files
POST /api/files/signed-urls.description: Creates direct upload or download links for several files, saying which were refused.

POST /api/files/pull.name: Fetch changed files
POST /api/files/pull.description: Sends the files that differ from your local copy, for the command-line tool.

GET /api/files/manifest.name: Rebuild file lists
GET /api/files/manifest.description: Returns freshly generated lists of the platform's files.

POST /api/files/watch.name: Register a watching session
POST /api/files/watch.description: Lets the command-line tool keep a folder in step, and keeps that link alive.

GET /api/files/watchers.name: Active watchers
GET /api/files/watchers.description: Lists the command-line sessions currently keeping folders in step.

GET /api/files/editor.name: File browser
GET /api/files/editor.description: Lists the files and folders in a folder for the browser editor.

GET /api/files/editor/content.name: Open file in editor
GET /api/files/editor/content.description: Returns a file's text plus details such as when it last changed.

PUT /api/files/editor/content.name: Save from the editor
PUT /api/files/editor/content.description: Saves a file from the browser editor and refuses if someone else changed it first.

POST /api/files/editor/folder.name: New folder
POST /api/files/editor/folder.description: Creates an empty folder in cloud storage.

DELETE /api/files/editor.name: Delete file or folder
DELETE /api/files/editor.description: Removes a file, or a folder and everything inside it.

POST /api/files/editor/rename.name: Rename or move
POST /api/files/editor/rename.description: Renames a file or folder, or moves it to another place.

POST /api/files/search.name: Search file contents
POST /api/files/search.description: Searches the text of workspace and solution files and returns one page of matches.

POST /api/forms/{form_id}/embed-secrets.name: Add form embed key
POST /api/forms/{form_id}/embed-secrets.description: Creates a key that lets another website show this form in its page.

GET /api/forms/{form_id}/embed-secrets.name: Form embed keys
GET /api/forms/{form_id}/embed-secrets.description: Lists the keys used to embed this form elsewhere, without showing the key values.

PATCH /api/forms/{form_id}/embed-secrets.name: Update form embed key
PATCH /api/forms/{form_id}/embed-secrets.description: Changes an embed key's label or switches it off.

DELETE /api/forms/{form_id}/embed-secret.name: Delete form embed key
DELETE /api/forms/{form_id}/embed-secret.description: Revokes an embed key so pages using it stop working.

GET /api/forms.name: Forms list
GET /api/forms.description: Lists the forms you can see, with their status and connections.

POST /api/forms.name: Create a form
POST /api/forms.description: Sets up a new form and saves it ready for editing.

GET /api/forms/{form_id}/publication-rev.name: Public sharing check
GET /api/forms/{form_id}/publication-rev.description: Checks whether a form is ready to be shared publicly and what would block it.

GET /api/forms/{form_id}/publication.name: Public sharing settings
GET /api/forms/{form_id}/publication.description: Shows whether a form is published and the link people use to reach it.

PUT /api/forms/{form_id}/publication.name: Publish a form
PUT /api/forms/{form_id}/publication.description: Makes a form publicly available and gives you a link to share.

DELETE /api/forms/{form_id}/publication.name: Unpublish a form
DELETE /api/forms/{form_id}/publication.description: Takes a form off the public web so its link stops working.

POST /api/forms/{form_id}/publication/ro.name: Change public form link
POST /api/forms/{form_id}/publication/ro.description: Issues a new public link and retires the old one.

GET /api/forms/{form_id}/runtime.name: Form for filling in
GET /api/forms/{form_id}/runtime.description: Returns everything the form needs to show itself to someone filling it in.

POST /api/forms/{form_id}/captcha/challe.name: Bot check
POST /api/forms/{form_id}/captcha/challe.description: Sets a small human check for a form so automated submissions are blocked.

GET /api/forms/{form_id}.name: Form details
GET /api/forms/{form_id}.description: Shows one form's questions, layout and settings.

PATCH /api/forms/{form_id}.name: Edit a form
PATCH /api/forms/{form_id}.description: Saves changes to a form's questions, layout or settings.

PUT /api/forms/{form_id}.name: Save form the old way
PUT /api/forms/{form_id}.description: Saves form changes through the older route so existing tooling keeps working.

POST /api/forms/{form_id}/logo.name: Upload form logo
POST /api/forms/{form_id}/logo.description: Sets the small square picture shown on the form.

DELETE /api/forms/{form_id}/logo.name: Remove form logo
DELETE /api/forms/{form_id}/logo.description: Clears the form's picture so no logo is shown.

DELETE /api/forms/{form_id}.name: Delete a form
DELETE /api/forms/{form_id}.description: Hides a form from use and, on request, removes it for good.

POST /api/forms/{form_id}/submissions.name: Submit a form
POST /api/forms/{form_id}/submissions.description: Runs the workflow behind a form with the answers someone gave.

POST /api/forms/{form_id}/startup.name: Prepare a form
POST /api/forms/{form_id}/startup.description: Runs the form's launch workflow to fill in starting choices and context.

POST /api/forms/{form_id}/fields/{field_.name: Refresh field choices
POST /api/forms/{form_id}/fields/{field_.description: Fetches the current choices for one question, such as a list of clients.

POST /api/forms/{form_id}/upload.name: Upload a form file
POST /api/forms/{form_id}/upload.description: Gives the browser a link to send a file the form asked for.
